title: Introduce presubmit workspace prober and lightweight lint-runtime shim
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: presubmit lanes have grown noisy and slow as we added cross-repo installs and larger toolchains. This PR introduces two orthogonal changes to reduce pre-merge feedback time and improve cache locality: 1) a presubmit workspace prober that performs a fast, permission-limited pre-warm of the workspace (dependency fetches, partial build outputs, and toolchain activation) using an overlay artifact so downstream presubmit steps see a warm filesystem; 2) a lightweight lint-runtime shim (Python) that normalizes inputs for lint actions and runs linters inside a tiny, deterministic runtime image to avoid repeated node/pnpm bootstraps in CI. Both pieces are designed to be opt-in and backward-compatible.

What changed (summary): added a new presubmit job template (ci/presubmit/prober.yml) that runs early in the presubmit pipeline, implemented an overlay artifact format (tools/overlay/README.md, tools/overlay/gen_overlay.py) and a small daemon that materializes platform-appropriate caches in the runner. Introduced lint-runtime-shim (tools/lint-shim/) — a ~120-line Python wrapper and a thin container image definition used by existing lint workflows. Updated several workflows to adopt the templated prober and the shim (.github/workflows/presubmit.yml, .github/workflows/lint.yml). Bumped actions/checkout to v4 and actions/setup-node to v4 in CI workflows; upgraded pnpm lockfile and pin for the lint shim image build. Minor package.json and dev-dep updates to ensure reproducible installs for the shim image.

Checklist:
- [x] Add prober template and overlay generator
- [x] Implement lint-runtime shim and container image
- [x] Wire presubmit and lint workflows to be opt-in via job template inputs
- [x] Add integration tests for prober (ci/tests/prober-smoke.sh)
- [x] Canary rollout to selected repos/teams for 24h

Testing & verification: ran canary across 6 active repos for 48 hours. Observed median presubmit wall time drop from ~95s to ~42s for jobs that previously reinstalled node+pnpm. Lint job cache hit rate increased from 28% to 78% after prober materialized node_modules overlay in the runner. CI checks listed below include smoke, unit, and e2e for prober and shim.

Rollout plan: merge to main, enable opt-in flag in library of presubmit templates (default off). After 1 week of monitoring, flip default to on for frontend teams. If regressions observed, revert by restoring previous workflow YAML versions (template pin included).

Rollback & risk: the overlay artifact is permission-limited and only writes to an ephemeral workspace overlay; worst-case risk is CI job failure (detected by smoke tests). The lint shim is a wrapper around existing linters; it can be bypassed by setting the workflow input lint_shim: false.

Related: ENG-2345 (presubmit perf), ENG-2410 (ci hygiene).
commits_summary: feat(prober): add overlay generator and prober job template
feat(lint-shim): introduce python shim and lightweight image
test(prober): add smoke test to validate overlay materialization
ci(workflows): opt-in wiring for presubmit and lint jobs
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Nice approach, can we ensure the overlay generator is hermetic across Linux runner images? Please add a small validation harness (suggested).
Maya Chen: Added a lightweight smoke harness and tied it into the prober workflow; gen_overlay.py now emits a SHA256 manifest used by the prober to validate contents.
Priya Nandakumar: The shim looks promising but we're concerned about Windows runners — can the shim detect and skip gracefully?
Maya Chen: Shim now inspects OS via runner environment and falls back to a no-op wrapper on unsupported platforms; documented in README.
Ben Holloway: Please add metrics around cache hit and wall time for the canary so SRE can validate SLA impact.
Maya Chen: Added basic metrics emission to the prober (prometheus pushgateway in canary only) and a dashboard link in the PR description.
release_notes: Add presubmit workspace prober and lightweight lint runtime shim. Opt-in presubmit template and overlay artifact reduce presubmit time and increase lint cache hit rates. CI actions bumped (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4). No user-facing API changes.
notes: This PR aims to reduce developer feedback loops. The prober and shim are opt-in; we will enable by default after monitoring. Observability added for early detection: temporary Prometheus push to canary.
migration_instructions: Enable the template in your repo by including ci/presubmit/prober.yml and set inputs.prober_enabled: true. To opt-out of the lint shim, set inputs.lint_shim: false in your lint workflow template.
canary_results_summary: Canary across 6 repos, 48h: median presubmit reduced 56%; lint cache hit from 28%->78%; no security incidents; two flaky Windows jobs bypassed shim automatically.
notes_for_ops: Ops: watch prober.materialize.failures and prober.cache_hit_ratio. Temporary pushgateway configured under redwood-ci/prober-canary for first 72h.
footnote: Authored and shepherded by DX infra; will follow up with a smaller PR to convert the overlay generator to Go if telemetry shows cross-runner variance.
